title: Integral scalar comparison preserves the specified isomorphism pullback shifts
statement: Fix a prime ell, an algebraic closure Omega/Q_ell, finite subextensions E≤L, and a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y with ell invertible. Specify integral shift structures for constructible pullback at E and L. At each coefficient stage suppose a natural inverse-image/pullback isomorphism has the prescribed inverseImagePullbackComparisonDerived components and commutes with the specified integral shift. Let alpha be any integral natural isomorphism with components integralPullbackScalarComparison. Then alpha commutes with those specified pullback shifts and the canonical integral scalar transition shifts. This is only the integral component of lem-pod-isomorphism-pullback-scalar-shift; no rational shift compatibility is assumed or concluded. Definitions: [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison], [def-pod-isomorphism-coefficient-inclusions].

source.place: Final automorphism sentence, integral comparison/shift part; steps 1--2 of the proof of lem-pod-isomorphism-pullback-scalar-shift. Extracted as a proved module to meet the single-file compilation limit.

proof.text: Identify the ordinary-to-completed comparison on the constructible subcategory with scalarCompletion by the uniqueness normalization of sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison. The defining integral scalar-shift normalization then gives CommShift for this natural isomorphism.

The ordinary inverse-image tensor comparison commutes with shifts because it is composed of mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso for exact functors. Conjugate by the specified eE and eL and by the ordinary-to-completed comparisons. The published isomorphismComparison_scalarExtension square and naturality of scalarCompletion identify the resulting transformation with alpha after the constructible inclusion. Faithfulness of that inclusion reflects its CommShift equation.

theorem isomorphismPullbackScalarIntegralShift
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y))
    (E L : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L)
    (sE : (constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g).CommShift ℤ)
    (eE : (sfIntegralConstructible l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y).ι ⋙ inverseImageIntegralDerived
      l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g ≅
      (constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g) ⋙ (sfIntegralConstructible l
      (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) X).ι)
    (heE : ∀ K, HEq (eE.hom.app K)
      (inverseImagePullbackComparisonDerived l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g hX hY K.obj))
    (hsE : (fun [_s : (constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g).CommShift ℤ] ↦
      NatTrans.CommShift eE.hom ℤ) (_s := sE))
    (sL : (constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) g).CommShift ℤ)
    (eL : (sfIntegralConstructible l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) Y).ι ⋙ inverseImageIntegralDerived
      l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) g ≅
      (constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) g) ⋙ (sfIntegralConstructible l
      (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) X).ι)
    (heL : ∀ K, HEq (eL.hom.app K)
      (inverseImagePullbackComparisonDerived l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) g hX hY K.obj))
    (hsL : (fun [_s : (constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) g).CommShift ℤ] ↦
      NatTrans.CommShift eL.hom ℤ) (_s := sL))
    (α : (constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g) ⋙
      (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.integralTransition l Ω X E L h) ≅
      (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.integralTransition l Ω Y E L h) ⋙
      (constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) g))
    (hα : ∀ K, α.app K = integralPullbackScalarComparison l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)
      (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) (isomorphismCoefficientInclusion l Ω E L h) g K) :
    (fun [_sE : (constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g).CommShift ℤ]
      [_sL : (constructibleIntegralPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) g).CommShift ℤ] ↦
      NatTrans.CommShift α.hom ℤ) (_sE := sE) (_sL := sL)
